class.name: WeatherProfile
class.brief_description: One weather state: clouds, rain, wind, fog and light.
class.description: A [Weather] node blends between profiles. Every float, color and vector property is blended (angles marked as degrees the short way round), including properties a script subclass adds, so a profile can carry values for your own [WeatherEffect]s: [codeblock] class_name SnowProfile extends WeatherProfile @export_range(0.0, 1.0) var snow := 0.0 [/codeblock]

method.name: blend
method.description: Returns a new profile between [param from] and [param to] at [param weight] ([code]0.0[/code] is [param from]).

method.name: get_param
method.description: Returns the value of a built-in parameter.

method.name: set_param
method.description: Sets the value of a built-in parameter.

members.member: How much of the sky is covered by clouds.
Darkens cloud undersides, for rain and storm clouds. Also dims the sky light (see [member WeatherLightingEffect.storm_sky_dimming]).
The weather type's name, used to pick it in a [WeatherLibrary].
Density of the cheap exponential distance fog ([member Environment.fog_density]). [code]0.0[/code] is off.
Added to the environment's volumetric fog density.
How much the wind varies in gusts, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].
Lightning flashes per minute. [code]0.0[/code] is none; a thunderstorm has 4 to 10.
Pulls the whole sky toward a flat grey and turns off the direct sun.
Rain, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]: drops, splashes, haze, sound and wetness.
Exposure multiplier. Below [code]1.0[/code] darkens the picture for thick clouds.
Wind heading in degrees: [code]0[/code] blows toward -Z, increasing clockwise seen from above.
Wind speed near the ground, in m/s.
